Today the arrest draws only a progress bar, with no shot or fleck, so that frame would honestly read NO. That is art or VFX work owed, not a flaw in the bar. These are the creature's own limbs, not the colonist grown limbs moved to 0.2.0, so the bar does not contradict the owner's move.
